name: Sodapoppin
description: Sodapoppin is a major Twitch personality, historically known for streaming World of Warcraft, who has made recurring guest appearances in VRChat's roleplay scene. His in-VRChat persona is often referred to as Sodapoppin80085 or simply Soda, and he is best known in the community for visiting [Roflgator](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/Roflgator)'s bar communities alongside other prominent streamers such as xQc and Hasanabi.
